scope: Bounded read-only administrative review; no full audit, mathematical review, credentials or service/network calls, Git mutation or unrelated sheet data.

in_memory_witness.mutation: registry PR1000 classification -> full_resolution_candidate; STATE unchanged

findings.title: Reconcile the operational partition with classified assertions
findings.mechanism: Range and STATE partition checks never compare registry classification or registry.full_resolution_candidates to the candidate set. A newly reclassified full claim may remain in the skipped set and be omitted from downstream verification.
findings.witness: In-memory only: change registry PR1000 classification from credited_prior_resolution to full_resolution_candidate, leave STATE unchanged. Both current full_range and scope_partition predicates remain true, while classified fulls disagree with candidates.
findings.fix: Require unique candidate/excluded/completed/accepted PR arrays; require registry full_resolution_candidate PRs and registry.full_resolution_candidates exactly equal STATE candidates, accepted keyset and completed keyset. Require registry source hold records to have explicit supported exclusion dispositions rather than treating a generic pending list as proof.

findings.title: Bind final remote acceptance to the adopted review authority
findings.mechanism: Current code checks config self-hashes but never cfg.head, STATE.current_final_authorities, authority review count, ROOT paper/archive pins, or equality between loaded native files and cfg.files. Exact merge verification is against the mutable accepted record alone. Four legacy packages have no current binary-to-final-seal comparison; #1001 count is hardcoded.
findings.witness: A config can point to an older ready seal while the current STATE authority points elsewhere, or accepted audited_and_merged_head can drift from cfg.head; neither discrepancy is tested. A legacy manifest and published files can differ from the final reviewed asset pins and still pass z.verify against each other.
findings.fix: Require cfg.pr/audit_folder/head match n, registry/intake/accepted head; cfg final_seal equals STATE selected current authority; cfg count equals authority whole_reviews_completed/fresh_whole_package_reviews. Compare full normalized native file tuples to cfg tuples and adopted seal asset pins. Legacy1001: compare PDF/archive SHA to receipts/FINAL_SEAL;1024/1025: PDF to FINAL_SEAL.mathematical_payload and both files to ZENODO_VERIFIED_BEFORE_TRACKER;1031: PDF to mathematical_payload and archive to archive_sha256. Check #1001 package_01/02/03 review_kind records, not a bare numeric constant.

findings.title: Validate pinned intake content rather than only path existence
findings.mechanism: Only repository_path dictionaries trigger PINS hash verification. The legacy string references and path dictionaries used throughout the range merely test exists(), although intake artifact hash pins already exist.
findings.witness: Editing intake/pr1000/artifacts/SCOPE.json without touching its path would not be rejected by current evidence check. Excluded current head/body checks do not detect local captured classification-evidence drift.
findings.fix: Resolve string/path references as implemented, then match any intake artifact path to its per-PR PINS.artifacts local_relative_path and enforce size/SHA. Require per-PR PINS head and intake head agree with registry and fresh excluded head. Pin/report existence-only source references separately rather than imply all referenced evidence bytes were validated.

findings.title: Verify the current public acceptance wording
findings.mechanism: Accepted PR bodies are checked only for a DOI substring. Current title/body can acquire overclaims or lose the accepted UNKNOWN overlap and unrefereed qualifications while retaining the same DOI and head.
findings.witness: Removing #1032 Luo-Zha UNKNOWN passage, or adding a firstness claim, while keeping DOI/head would pass the final auditor.
findings.fix: For14 newer workflows compare fresh title/body exactly with service_receipts/PR_UPDATE_PAYLOAD.json. For legacy4 compare authoritative saved accepted title/body where available, or explicitly independently read and approve their fresh wording with new bounded evidence. Preserve historical original description inside the accepted body rather than interpreting it as the operative scope.

safe_existing_features: No remote writes: only gh GraphQL GET-equivalent query, Zenodo GET, DOI HEAD and GWS get paths.
Raw GWS A:D response remains in memory. Saved rows are only exact DOI matches for this batch; command receipts store output hashes.
Native client restricts token-bearing URLs to selected HTTPS Zenodo host; DOI resolver has no API token.
Failures are fail-closed and each full audit attempt uses a new folder.
Parent's proposed post-PASS pending-array cleanup preserves captured old seals/history; final isolated checkpoint remains a distinct required gate.
